route: Gut D-glucose dataset; UV positions anatomically unmapped

site_labels.interpretation: position-associated prediction; not nutrient-specific or anatomical targeting proof

motor.interpretation: Recorded motor-channel variance; low-amplitude fluctuations may be recording noise, not verified swimming.

protocol.name: late-within-condition independent holdout
protocol.evaluation_censoring: stop at next UV pulse or recording end; require at least20 scored seconds
protocol.penalty: 2I + 20 D.T@D, independent lag blocks; intercept and common time-polynomial nuisance unpenalized
protocol.common_session_drift: degree3 polynomial included identically in all models; time centered/scaled on training rows only; degree fixed without response-based tuning
protocol.drift_sensitivity_audit: original_no_drift retains the same split and models without timepolynomial; this sensitivity check was added after a blocked-design negative-control audit, not prospectively registered
protocol.scaling: training-row RMS of each intact lagged regressor block, zero-preserving
protocol.analysis_binning: mean of 1 consecutive sourceframes; visual value is moving-grating fraction within bin
protocol.error_reduction_definition: 100*(MSE baseline - MSE full)/MSE baseline; mean of per-trial values
warnings: Conditional predictability is not causal or a pure interoceptive signal.
Internal nutrient field names refer to the selected position code; anatomical mapping is unverified.
Unclassified UV-position response windows (55s) are excluded from training and evaluation.
Position blocks can be confounded with session time, nonlinear drift and compound depletion; random interleaving is not demonstrated.
A common cubic time nuisance tests slow-drift sensitivity but cannot remove all time/condition confounding.
Two held-out trials per condition are a small within-recording check, not a statistically validated cell population.
Motor activity can mediate nutrient responses, not only confound them.
Late-within-condition holdout is not prospective whole-session forecasting.
Source-preprocessed fluorescence is not a validated online preprocessing system.
Cells are not independent animal replicates; coordinates are native recording space.
